channel.title: Ether-MOSH News + Updates
channel.description: Satirical, sourced effect and mode education with practical production guides from Ether-MOSH.

item.title: Make ASCII Collapse Admit It Is Not Actually Text
item.description: Learn how the ASCII Collapse effect uses cell sampling and a luminance-shaped mask, plus practical Ether-MOSH Amount and Cell settings for motion, print, and projection.

item.title: Make the Duotone Effect Pick a Side
item.description: Learn how the duotone effect maps image luminance between two colors and how to set Ether-MOSH Mix and Hue for print-inspired graphics, motion, and projection.

item.title: Posterize the Image Before the Gradient Files a Complaint
item.description: Learn how the posterize effect quantizes RGB tones and how to set Ether-MOSH Levels and Bias for posters, patterns, motion, projection, and accessible graphics.

item.title: Turn the Kaleidoscope Effect Until the Room Confesses
item.description: Learn how the kaleidoscope effect uses mirrored radial symmetry and how to set Ether-MOSH Segments and Spin for patterns, motion, projection, print, and education.

item.title: Your Pattern Doesn't Tile—Stop Gaslighting the Seam
item.description: Learn how Ether-MOSH Pattern mode, labeled Motif and Motif Maestro, builds seamless tiles and repeat proofs from Forge, uploaded images, or camera stills.

item.title: Forge Mode Already Started the Fight
item.description: Learn how Ether-MOSH Forge Mode combines six seeded procedural generators, effect stacks, crossfades, audio response, seamless controls, and print-ready exports.

item.title: Your Fake CRT Looks Cheap—Stop at the Scanlines
item.description: Learn how CRT displays form images and how to use Ether-MOSH CRT Curvature, Shadow Mask, and Bloom for live visuals, motion design, installations, and print.

item.title: Break the Keyframes Before Lunch
item.description: Learn how datamoshing uses video-compression logic and how to control Ether-MOSH Datamosh for loops, live visuals, music videos, projections, and print stills.

item.title: Make Moire Before Moire Makes You Sick
item.description: Understand moire interference and learn practical Ether-MOSH Moire settings for op art, projection mapping, live visuals, print proofs, patterns, and education.

item.title: Halftone Is Not a Phase, Mom—Put These Dots Everywhere
item.description: Learn halftone printing history and practical Ether-MOSH Halftone settings for posters, patterns, motion graphics, projection, and print production.

item.title: Sort Your Pixels Before They Sort You
item.description: Learn what pixel sorting is, where the glitch-art technique came from, and how to use Ether-MOSH Pixel Sort for video, print, projection, patterns, and motion graphics.
